t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in fixed colour pairs. Orange, red, blue and green lead to a bright forest. Purple, brown, yellow lead to a dark forest. the number of mushrooms always changes. Ignore their hats and positions

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in fixed pairs but their position on the screen changes. I found that the gnomes in the dark forest gave more mushrooms but it depended on the round of the game and the side of the screen they were on.
